about:
WCJ Pilgrim Wire was founded in 1998 in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, by William Jones, who remains the company’s president. Initially focused on supplying high‑quality stitching wire to the graphic arts industry, the business expanded over the years to serve industrial, baling, brush, packaging and automotive markets. In 2017 the company partnered with DDD Group and opened its first dedicated manufacturing facility in York, Pennsylvania, where it continues to produce wire products using domestic steel.

The company manufactures a broad range of wire products including coated and electro‑plated wire, industrial wire, spring and music wire, brush and broom staple wire, flat wire, stitching wire and custom wire solutions. Its capabilities cover custom base materials, plating types (copper, zinc, tin, nickel, polymer), tensile requirements, diameters and packaging. The York facility operates an eco‑friendly Electroshield™ electroplating line and provides wire handling equipment such as spooling and de‑spooling systems. A team of roughly 15 employees manages production, quality, sales and logistics.

WCJ Pilgrim serves customers in industrial manufacturing, graphic arts and publishing, waste disposal and recycling, medical device production, brush and broom manufacturing, HVAC ducting, food processing and transportation. The company also supplies baling wire for packaging and box‑binding applications and provides wire for automotive components.

The founder’s stated mission is to make the highest quality wire using the latest state‑of‑the‑art machines and components in America. WCJ Pilgrim emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certification, expedited turnaround times, and the ability to develop custom wire products for niche or specialty applications.
